Subject: Request for commercial pricing - BigBank RFP 2025

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for engaging on our RFP. Procurement has asked for a clear commercial response for the pricing section of the RFP. Please provide a single-page pricing grid and an explicit description of the following items:

- Hosted (pay-as-you-go) token pricing (prompt / completion / streaming where applicable) expressed per 1K tokens; any minimum billing units.
- Dedicated (reserved) commit tiers: monthly and annual commit pricing, effective committed rates, and example consumption scenarios.
- Overages: how overages are billed (rate relative to committed rate, grace thresholds, true-up cadence).
- Discount structures: volume thresholds, multi-year discounts, and any early-payment incentives.
- Licensing/enterprise add-ons: SLA upgrades, compliance packages (HIPAA/HIPAA+), observability retention, and dedicated support bundles — please provide line-item pricing or uplift percentages.
- Billing terms: invoicing cadence (monthly/quarterly), payment terms (Net30/Net45), and late-payment penalties.

We have attached the RFP commercial appendix (BigBank_RFP_Attachment.pdf) for placement. Can you confirm you can return a completed commercial appendix plus a short cover email by EOD 2025-06-17? If you need a template, please use the attached appendix.

Regards,
Sara Kent
Senior Procurement Manager
BigBank Financial Services

From: rohan_mehta@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Draft pricing for BigBank RFP — internal

Team — drafting notes for the commercial grid. Proposed structure below (we'll translate into the appendix and the spreadsheet):

Option A — Hosted (Pay-as-you-go) — public-hosted API (no commit)
- Prompt tokens: $0.40 per 1K tokens
- Completion tokens: $0.80 per 1K tokens
- Streaming (chunked responses): billed as completion tokens at the completion rate; minimum bill unit 1 token
- Embeddings (1K dims): $0.10 per 1K tokens (separate line)

Option B — Dedicated (Reserved capacity) — monthly commit model
- Commit tiers (monthly):
  - Bronze: $15,000/mo commit — effective blended token rate ~ $0.22 per 1K tokens (expected throughput 40M tokens/mo)
  - Silver: $45,000/mo commit — effective blended token rate ~ $0.16 per 1K tokens (expected throughput 140M tokens/mo)
  - Gold: $120,000/mo commit — effective blended token rate ~ $0.10 per 1K tokens (expected throughput 400M tokens/mo)

Overages and true-up:
- Overage rate = 1.20x of the committed effective blended rate for the tier
- We allow a 10% monthly burst cushion before overage billing is applied
- Quarterly true-up for sustained overages; annual reconciliation and credits applied at renewal

Discounts / multi-year:
- 12-month committed term: additional 15% off committed dollars (applies to Silver and Gold tiers)
- 24-month committed term: 25% off committed dollars + priority capacity scheduling
- Early-payment discount: 2% if paid within 10 days of invoice

Add-ons:
- SLA upgrade (99.9 -> 99.95): +10% of committed fee
- HIPAA package (business associate agreement + logging retention): one-time setup $40k + +8% uplift on committed fee
- Extended observability retention (12 months -> 36 months): $5k/month per environment

Billing terms:
- Default: monthly invoicing, Net30; Net45 negotiable for enterprise procurement with approved credit
- Overages invoiced monthly; annual reconciliation credit/charge applied at renewal

Legal / Contract notes (for Evelyn): we should restrict auto-charge overage language to a prior-notification flow (email escalation at 80% and 100% of commit) and allow a one-time waiver for first-time overage during onboarding.

I'll put this into the worksheet and attach examples with line items. Thoughts?

— Rohan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Dedicated_Commit_Tiers.xlsx]

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, rohan_mehta@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft pricing for BigBank RFP — internal (legal input)

Thanks team. A few legal points to include in the commercial appendix and the contract redline: 

1) Overage billing — require a 30-day cure period for disputed overage invoices before penalties; include an 80% notification and 5 business-day grace to allow customers to add burst capacity.
2) Price escalation — clear language that committed rates are fixed for the term, with an annual CPI-based adjustment only for non-committed/PAYG rates.
3) Credits — define mechanics for annual reconciliation credits in plain language (we'll include a worked example).
4) Confidentiality — commercial appendix should be marked "Confidential — Pricing" and included in the NDA/PSA attachments.

I will draft the relevant clauses and circulate redlines. We should also ensure the HIPAA uplift is described as a compliance support package, not a warranty on BigBank compliance.

Evelyn Hart
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
